capital.evidence_quote: Bridgetown is the capital and primary commercial seaport of the Republic of Barbados

currency.evidence_quote: The Barbados Dollar (BBD) is pegged to the US Dollar at 2 BBD = 1 USD; USD is accepted everywhere

timezone.evidence_quote: Barbados observes Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 year-round with no seasonal daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Barbados is 115V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Alternating current grid frequency is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: North American Type A and Type B plugs with two flat pins are universally used in Barbados

police.evidence_quote: Dial 211 for emergency police response across Barbados

sources.title: Queen Elizabeth Hospital Emergency Ambulance Service

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 511 for emergency medical services and QEH ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 311 for fire and rescue emergency services

general.evidence_quote: 211 is the central emergency operations number in Barbados

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist precinct patrols along the South and West coasts coordinate via 211

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Barbados Karayipler'in en güvenli ve istikrarlı ada ülkelerinden biridir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Barbados is one of the safest and most developed Caribbean nations; exercise standard travel precautions.

advisory_headline.ru: Барбадос — один из самых безопасных и развитых карибских курортов; действуют обычные меры предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Barbados es uno de los destinos más seguros y estables del Caribe; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Barbados reach approximately 48.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Barbados exceed 115.0 Mbps with fiber-optic rollout

esim_sim_notes.value: Flow and Digicel provide high-speed 4G LTE tourist eSIMs at Grantley Adams International Airport (BGI). Arriving passengers must submit the online Immigration/Customs form at travelform.gov.bb prior to arrival.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: All arriving passengers must complete the online digital immigration form within 72 hours of travel

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 75%, predominantly Anglican, Pentecostal, and Adventist)
religion.evidence_quote: Anglicanism represents the historic church of Barbados alongside vibrant evangelical congregations

festivals.value: Crop Over Festival (climaxing with Grand Kadooment in August), Oistins Fish Festival, Barbados Food and Rum Festival
festivals.evidence_quote: Crop Over celebrates the historic sugarcane harvest with six weeks of soca music and masquerade bands

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage clothing of any style is strictly illegal in Barbados for civilians and tourists; camouflage gear is reserved exclusively for the Barbados Defence Force. Nudism and topless sunbathing are prohibited on all public beaches.

sources.title: The Barbados Police Service Law Bulletin

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: It is a serious statutory offence under Barbadian law for non-military persons to wear camouflage clothing

tipping.value: A 10% service charge is usually included on restaurant and hotel bills; leaving an extra 5-10% for exceptional dining service is customary.
tipping.evidence_quote: Most bills include a 10% service charge; an additional modest tip is appreciated for good service
